from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u035/system/state/workspace/programs')
p.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 2 for v in row))
    top_colors = {v for row in grid[:divider] for v in row if v != 0}
    color = next(iter(top_colors))
    top_cols = {c for row in grid[:divider] for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color}
    bottom_cols = {c for row in grid[divider + 1:] for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color}
    for c in top_cols & bottom_cols:
        for r in range(1, divider):
            if out[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = 4
    return out
'''
